names.note: Name page 10081 of days.pravoslavie.ru is «Мавра (Моисеева), мц.»; the grade is stripped and the surname kept, the day line itself giving only «Мавры». `fk.mjs` on the stored string returns NONE and a Cyrillic grep for «Моисеева» over every `saint.json` returns nothing; the corpus's four other women of the name stand on other days and none bears this surname.

death.note: The day line closes «(1937)», one year for the whole company of eight; no year of birth anywhere.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 28 июля ст. ст. — «Прмч. Василия , прмцц. Анастасии и Елены , мчч. Арефы , Иоанна , Иоанна , Иоанна и мц. Мавры (1937).»

attestations.note: The last of the eight the day's eleventh entry names, and the only one it heads «мц.», a woman martyr without the «прмц.» the two nuns carry — so she is written as a laywoman and NOT as a monastic, which is a reading of that one abbreviation and is recorded as one. It is an ENUMERATED COMPANY OF EIGHT which BRIEF.md §4 makes eight folders, and this draft holds all eight. The line and name page 10081 agree: «мц.» on both, with no rank in the church, so `martyr` is all that is written and NO `office` IS WRITTEN. THE LINE AND THE NAME PAGE ARE ALL THERE IS: no life page stands behind the entry, and THE 26 ЯНВАРЯ SYNAXIS PAGE WAS NOT OPENED. The day page prints no hymn under any of the eight names.
